title: Kernel-check byte-order compatibility and finite record composition
description: Use the installed Lean 4.36 kernel to check both endian compositions, the exact palindrome condition and a bijection with 16 independent bits. Prove finite-record composition by induction conditional on a one-record suffix law. A disposable false mixed-identity theorem must be rejected. This checks the algebra and records its assumptions separately from the Java encoder and SAT evidence.
expected: Five printed kernel axiom inventories, no sorry and a rejected false-identity control.

steps.name: Check and challenge the wire calculus
